messages:
maya: Kicking off a slightly different bring-up thread for v3.1-int4-shadow+ab. Focus: combine short canary with dedicated A/B cohorts and a replay-based smoke pass. Planning a 3-pronged validation: live canary, shadow long-doc quiet-burn, and replay harness for known edge prompts.

ash: Replay harness is great. Which corpus are we using? The previous one missed a couple of privacy-heavy prompts.

maya: Using: (1) last 7 days prod anonymized top-100k prompts, (2) synthetic long-doc set from docs-team, (3) targeted safety edge cases from ops. Replay will run deterministically against v3.0 (control) and v3.1-int4 (treatment).

kevin: For A/B cohorts I suggest splitting by customer tier and device type. Business tier gets a stricter fidelity gate so we don't regress SLAs for premium customers.

liam: Agreed. Proposed cohort gates: free/default cohort uses fidelity threshold -1.25% rel; business cohort uses -0.5% rel. Also require business cohort to have KV warmup >=97% in first 1k requests.

eva: Can we add per-cohort parse-fidelity (structured outputs) and a token-efficiency metric (tokens-per-answer) so we capture cost regressions?

maya: Yes. New metrics list: fidelity (composite), mrr_abs_drop, halluc_rate_pp, structured_parse_fail_pp, tokens_per_response_delta. Will enforce cost guardrails: tokens_per_response increase >+10% triggers manual review (not immediate rollback).

ash: What's the auto-fallback policy? We should be clear about hysteresis to avoid flapping.

maya: Draft policy below (simplified):

```yaml
canary_plan:
  steps:
    - traffic: 1%
      hold: 15m
    - traffic: 5%
      hold: 30m
    - traffic: 25%
      hold: 2h
  cohorts: [default, business, longdoc-shadow]
  replay_check: true
  metrics_checks:
    default:
      fidelity_rel_threshold: -0.0125
      min_sample: 2000
      consecutive_windows: 2
    business:
      fidelity_rel_threshold: -0.005
      kv_warmup_min: 0.97
      min_sample: 1000
      consecutive_windows: 1
  cost_guard:
    tokens_per_response_pct_increase: 0.10
    action: manual_review
  auto_fallback:
    immediate_metrics: [mrr_abs_drop, halluc_rate_pp, kv_warmup]
    immediate_action: rollback
    composite_metrics: [fidelity]
    composite_action: rollback_if_2_consecutive
  flapping_protection:
    cooldown_after_rollback: 2h
```

kevin: Love the cooldown. Also add a rule: if replay harness shows >1% discordant critical failures vs control on the same prompts, block promote until triage.

maya: Added to runbook: replay discordance block. Also adding note to tie A/B metric comparisons to pre-registered evaluation slices to avoid p-hacking.

deploy-bot: Canary queued: v3.1-int4 ab-run id r-2026032402. Initial 1% cohort split active.

liam: Monitoring note: make sure the dashboard surfaces cohort breakdowns and replay diffs side-by-side; ops needs easy triage links.

ash: Also recommend we publish a short changelog of known quantization artifacts (e.g., punctuation trimming on long prompt tails) to customer-facing notes if we see it in replay. Transparency helps.

maya: Will prepare post-smoke summary template: per-cohort tables, replay delta histogram, top-20 discordant prompts, and recommended action (promote/manual vs rollback).

kevin: One last thing: schedule the quiet-burn shadow for 48h for long-docs instead of 24h. Long-tail needs more coverage.

maya: Updated plan: longdoc-shadow 48h. Running replay now against the corpuses; I'll post results in this thread when ready.
